access.encryptedBackupsAreCreatedByTheServerOpe: Encrypted backups are created by the server operator. Verification restores the archive into a separate database and compares every table against the backup snapshot.
access.individualStaffAccountsAClearAuditTrailA: Individual staff accounts, a clear audit trail and verified recovery.
access.keepAnEncryptedCopyOffTheApplicationServ: Keep an encrypted copy off the application server and the recovery key in a separate secure location. A local archive alone does not protect against losing the server.

access.noBackupHasBeenRecordedYet: No backup has been recorded yet
access.shareSecurelyWithThisStaffMemberTheyMust: Share securely with this staff member. They must replace it at first sign-in.
access.temporaryPasswordSavedAllDevicesWereSign: Temporary password saved. All devices were signed out.
access.thisSignsTheStaffMemberOutEverywhereThey: This signs the staff member out everywhere. They must change this temporary password at next sign-in.
access.permissionSummary: Owner: all access and staff administration. Manager: all shop operations and corrections. Cashier: customers, sales, orders and incoming payments. Viewer: read-only. All roles can view shop records and reports. Opening balances, refunds and corrections require Manager or Owner.

notices.accessSaved: Staff access saved. Existing sessions for edited accounts were revoked.

roles.managerDescription: All shop operations, including metal purchases, opening balances, refunds and corrections.
roles.cashierDescription: Customers, incoming payments, sales and orders. Read access to shop records and reports.
roles.ownerDescription: Full shop access, staff administration and recovery status.
roles.viewerDescription: Read shop records and reports. Cannot create or change transactions.

recovery.setupHelp: Ask your server administrator to configure the backup key, daily backups and regular restore verification before rollout.
